parameters.query:
SELECT knowledge_source_id
FROM knowledge_source_registry
WHERE knowledge_source_id = $1
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO knowledge_source_registry (
  knowledge_source_id,
  source_type,
  source_name,
  original_file_name,
  source_date,
  customer,
  site,
  unit,
  uploaded_by,
  upload_timestamp,
  source_url,
  verification_status,
  confidence_level,
  file_hash,
  file_size,
  media_type,
  description
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, COALESCE($10, NOW()), $11, $12, $13, $14, $15, $16, $17
)
RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: "Knowledge source created successfully", data: $json } }}
